name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: The colonist in the Lumen module's distance is between Anders and the Engineer.
The colonist studying Regolith's distance is at least 2 ly more than the Captain.
Beacon goes with exactly two of Anders, Navigator, Diatoms, and 14 ly.
The colonist in the Forge module's distance is immediately below the colonist studying Regolith.
Bauer's distance is higher than both the Pilot and the colonist in the Beacon module.
The colonist in the Beacon module's distance is immediately below Cho.
The colonist studying Regolith's distance is immediately next to Okafor.
The Engineer's distance is exactly 2 ly more than the colonist studying Algae.
Bauer's distance is exactly 2 ly more than the colonist in the Beacon module.
